lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Halcyon, docked against Kestrel's flank. The first warm air in days.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Hey. You were supposed to be on station.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: I was. When they came out of the walls, Hollis and I got thirty people into the lower ring and sealed it. Then I came looking for you.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: I told you not to take the long way.

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: I took the Throat. Moss named it.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Vey... where are your escorts? Where's Nanda?

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Finch, Wren and Kite. We lost all three in the Throat. Nanda, Sefa, Dov.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: Oh, Vey. I'm so sorry. You kept the promise anyway. You came.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: The survivors are holding in the lower ring, and Abara is with them. Abara says go, and draw the Weave away from the station.

lines.speaker: li
lines.text: So we're coming with you. Halcyon brings long-range comms and seeker drones. Tern brings docking clamps, so we can lock two hulls together when we need the muscle.

lines.speaker: engineer
lines.text: And I bring one alien point-defence turret, fresh off the wreck. My birthday came early.
